scientific_evidence_role: prospective acquisition contract only; no downloaded model bytes, import result, lifecycle result, numerical result, superiority, or SOTA claim

implementation.network_client: Python urllib.request with one logical request per file and no application retry loop
implementation.difference_from_v1: v2 requires exact per-file SHA-256 in addition to paths, byte sizes, file count, and total bytes, and does not call snapshot_download.

scheduler.start_condition: Wave1 controller is terminal, all Wave1 model services have stopped, and an independent read-only process audit reports no references to the new target.
scheduler.mac_to_server_transfer: If direct server download is unavailable, use only resumable sftp limited to 4096 Kbit/s and retain the identical target and evidence identities.

execution_contract.server_root_injection: Set AGENT_ENHANCE_REMOTE_ROOT immediately before execution; it must resolve to a writable project root named AgentEnhance on an approved high-capacity volume.

acceptance: The scheduler start condition is independently observed before the command starts.
Exactly the seven frozen allowlisted files are materialized from the immutable revision.
Every observed file byte size and SHA-256 exactly matches its frozen manifest row.
The observed file count is 7 and total bytes are 713308492.
The evidence record reports network_retry_count=0 and every attempt reports logical_request_attempt=1 and retry_count=0.
The evidence root contains TERMINAL_ACCEPTED, lacks TERMINAL_REJECTED, and its evidence inventory verifies independently.
failure: Any premature start, path collision, timeout, HTTP error, unsafe path, byte overflow, byte mismatch, SHA-256 mismatch, allowlist mismatch, or evidence mismatch seals the fresh evidence root as TERMINAL_REJECTED. The partial target is retained and never repaired or deleted in place.
next_gate_after_acceptance: Independently audit the immutable snapshot, then freeze and materialize an isolated Python 3.11 environment. Model acceptance does not authorize import, lifecycle, or benchmark execution.
prohibited_actions: starting while Wave1 or any Wave1 model service remains active
using a moving model revision or accepting ETag as a content hash
accepting paths or byte sizes without exact per-file SHA-256
adding application retries after a network failure
repairing, resuming, deleting, or overwriting a rejected target in place
loading the model or installing dependencies during this acquisition-only stage
populating a comparison-table numeric cell from this gate
